case: N31-02 leg C category and city-level sales oracle
method: Independent event-level calculation: select order_created/order_paid for the business date; map item product_id to the latest product category at or before the date; map user_id to the latest registered city_level at or before the date; include only paid order items; subtract completed refund amount once by refund_id; sale_count is item quantity; recompute ratio from window gross sales.
limitations: The fixture has no missing category or city-level row in this business-date paid-order subset; unknown-row preservation is covered by the focused Spark SQL regression, not this browser E2E case.
The fixture carries category IDs but no category-name dimension, so this E2E oracle asserts IDs and additive values rather than inventing names.
